## Interrupting Commands

Start a long-running process and send Ctrl-C:

```{term}
sleep 999 #! expect_prompt: false
ctrl-c #! literal: false, wait: 1.0, expect_prompt: true
```

## Sending Special Keys

### Tab Completion

```{term}
echo /us #! enter: false
tab #! literal: false, hold: 0.3, enter: false, expect_prompt: false
enter #! literal: false
```

### Arrow Keys (Command History)

```{term}
echo "first"
echo "second"
echo "third"
```

Now press up three times to recall "first":

```{term}
up #! literal: false, hold: 0.1, enter: false, expect_prompt: false
up #! literal: false, hold: 0.1, enter: false, expect_prompt: false
up #! literal: false, hold: 0.1, enter: false, expect_prompt: false
enter #! literal: false
```

## Waiting for Slow Commands

Use `hold` to give commands time to produce output:

```{term}
sleep 1 && echo "Done sleeping" #! hold: 1.5
```

## Hidden Setup Cells

Sometimes you need to run setup that shouldn't appear in the document:

```{term}
#| output: false
export SECRET_TOKEN="abc123"
alias ll='ls -la'
```

Now use the alias (the setup isn't shown):

```{term}
echo "Token is: $SECRET_TOKEN"
```
